international.title: Princess of Wales documentary Heal charts ‘pilgrimage’ after cancer treatment
international.summary: BBC film follows Catherine as she undertakes Three Peaks challenge to search for what life can be post-chemotherapy On the day the Princess of Wales undertook the Three Peaks challenge, there was rain, hill fog and, finally, watery June sunshine. It is hard to not see it as a meteorological metaphor for Catherine’s journey – from cancer diagnosis through treatment and to remission – as she treks first Ben Nevis, then Scafell Pike and Yr Wyddfa (Snowdon) within 24 hours, the camera capturing her physical challenge for a new documentary.
